name: EndoRobotics
description: EndoRobotics is a surgical robotics company based in Seoul, South Korea. The company develops the [ROBOPERA](/robot/endorobotics_robopera) modular add-on robotic platform and instruments for therapeutic gastrointestinal endoscopy (including ESD, ESG, EMR, and endoscopic stitching), distributed globally in partnership with Olympus.
